summary: Caution: helicopter fast rope operations at the Foss landing zone at EGUN limit use of taxiway Alpha.
text:
CAUTION: HEL FAST ROPE OPS IN PROGRESS IN FOSS HEL
LANDING ZONE LOCATED IN GRASSY AREA OF TWY ALPHA AND 
DELTA. ACFT MAY NOT UTILIZE TWY ALPHA BTN THE HAMMERHEAD 
AND AIR MOBILITY COMMAND RAMP WHEN AIRBORNE OPS AT FOSS 
ARE IN PROGRES. SIMULTANEOUS NON-352 SPECIAL OPS
WING ACFT ARR OR DEP OPS TO THE RWY AND FOSS ARE AUTHORIZED.
